未提交的改动将先贮藏，完成后自动恢复（--autostash）。: Uncommitted changes are stashed first and restored afterwards (--autostash).
没有文本改动（例如仅修改了权限），只能对整个文件操作: No text changes (e.g. only permissions changed). Operations can only be applied to the entire file
添加后将执行一次获取。即使获取失败，远程也已添加，可在右键菜单中修改地址或删除。: A fetch runs after adding. If it fails, the remote is still added; change its URL or remove it from the context menu.
点击即可切换。: Click one to switch to it.
点击一行查看 git 输出。仅记录会修改仓库或访问网络的命令，关闭标签页后清空。: Click a row to see git's output. Only commands that change something or use the network are recorded; the log is cleared when the tab closes.
点击一行跳转到修改该行的提交；使用上下方向键选择，按 Enter 跳转: Click a line to jump to the commit that changed it; use Up/Down to select a line, Enter to jump
点击仓库即可在新标签页中打开。: Click a repository to open it in a new tab.
点击关闭按钮仅隐藏窗口，可从托盘图标的右键菜单退出。: The close button only hides the window; quit from the tray icon's context menu.
点击改动行以选中，按住 Shift 可连续选择；按空格键暂存，按 Delete: Click lines · Space: stage · Del: discard
点击目录进入；仓库将克隆到所选目录下: Click a directory to enter it; the repository will be cloned into the selected directory
点击目录进入；标有「仓库」的目录可直接打开: Click a directory to enter it; those marked “Repository” can be opened
选择一个提交以查看改动: Select a commit to view its changes
当前处于分离的 HEAD 状态，请先切换到分支: HEAD is detached; switch to a branch first
当前处于分离的 HEAD 状态，请先切换到分支再拉取: HEAD is detached; switch to a branch before pulling
当前处于分离的 HEAD 状态，请先切换到分支再推送: HEAD is detached; switch to a branch before pushing
由服务器连接远程仓库，存放位置须已存在。: The server connects to the remote repository; the parent directory must already exist.
登录 Windows 后自动启动；如已开启托盘选项，将直接最小化到托盘。: Starts automatically after you sign in to Windows; goes straight to the system tray if a tray option is on.
登录被拒绝：密钥或密码错误，或已取消输入: Sign-in rejected: wrong key or password, or the prompt was cancelled
端口须为 1～65535 之间的数字: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
请等待「{running}」完成后重试: Wait for “{running}” to finish, then try again
等待 git 退出失败: Failed to wait for git to exit
结束当前程序并重新启动: End the running program and restart
可以快进时快进，否则生成合并提交。: Fast-forward when possible; otherwise create a merge commit.
可打开服务器上仓库的 Git 客户端，本机和服务器上的仓库使用同一界面。: A Git client that can open repositories on servers: one interface for local and server repositories.
获取和推送均使用此地址。: Use this address for both fetching and pushing.
获取完成，已清理远程已删除的分支: Fetch complete; branches deleted on the remote have been pruned
获取，并清理远程已删除的分支（--prune）: Fetch and prune branches deleted on the remote (--prune)
推送被拒绝：远程分支包含本地没有的提交。请先拉取再推送。: Push rejected: the remote branch has commits you don't have locally. Pull, then push.
认证失败。请检查用户名、密码或密钥是否有该仓库的访问权限。: Authentication failed. Check that the username, password, or key has access to this repository.
读取消息附带的数据时连接中断: Connection lost while reading attached message data
跳过正在重放的提交：其改动（包括已解决的冲突）将被丢弃，变基将继续处理后续提交。: Skip the commit being replayed: its changes (including resolved conflicts) will be discarded, and the rebase continues with the rest.
转发本机的 ssh-agent（仅对受信任的服务器启用）: Forward the local ssh-agent (trusted servers only)
还有 {left} 处冲突未解决：请逐处选择版本，或在「手动编辑」中修改后保存。: {left} {left|conflict is|conflicts are} still unresolved: pick a side for each, or fix them under “Edit manually”, then save.
有 {n} 个本机终端正在运行，退出将结束其中的程序。服务器上的终端不受影响。: {n} local {n|terminal is|terminals are} still running; quitting ends {n|its program|their programs}. Terminals on servers keep running.
仍有不完整的冲突标记（<<<<<<<、=======、>>>>>>>）。请在「手: Incomplete conflict markers remain (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>). Remove them under “Edit manually”, then save.
存在未解决的冲突。请在「本地修改」中解决后重试。: There are unresolved conflicts. Resolve them in “Local changes”, then try again.
尚未提交：请检查后点击上方的「提交合并」，如需放弃，请点击「中止」。: Not committed yet: review it, then click “Commit merge” above, or “Abort” to drop it.
暂无本机仓库。请点击「添加本机仓库…」或「克隆…」。: No local repositories yet. Click “Add local repository…” or “Clone…”.
暂无记录。提交、切换分支、获取、推送等操作将记录在此处。: Nothing recorded yet. Commits, branch switches, fetches and pushes are listed here once they run.
暂无此服务器上的仓库。请点击「打开仓库…」选择。: No repositories on this server yet. Click “Open repository…” to pick one.
暂无；提交后，说明将记录在此处: None yet; messages are remembered here after you commit
此仓库正在{op}，关闭标签页将取消该操作。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; closing the tab will cancel it.
此仓库正在{op}，请等待完成后再关闭。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; wait for it to finish before closing.
此仓库正在{op}，请等待完成后再移动。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; wait for it to finish before moving it.
此仓库正在{op}，请等待完成后再移除。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; wait for it to finish before removing it.
此仓库尚无远程。请先在侧栏的「远程」上右键选择「添加远程…」。: This repository has no remotes yet. Right-click “Remotes” in the sidebar and choose “Add remote…” first.
此分支未设置上游，推送后将自动设置。: This branch has no upstream. Pushing sets it automatically.
此分支包含尚未合并的提交。: This branch has commits that have not been merged yet.
此名称已被使用，请换一个。: This name is already in use. Choose another.
此工作区中有标签页正在执行操作，请等待完成后再删除。: A tab in this workspace is busy. Wait for it to finish before deleting the workspace.
此工作区中没有最近关闭的标签页。: No recently closed tabs in this workspace.
此工作区中没有打开的标签页。: This workspace has no open tabs.
此工作区中暂无仓库。打开的仓库将归入此工作区。: This workspace has no repositories yet. Repositories you open are added to it.
此提交不在当前分支上。请先切换到包含该提交的分支。: This commit is not on the current branch. Switch to a branch that contains it first.
此提交之后有 {n} 个提交，一次最多整理 {max} 个。请选择更近的提交。: There are {n} commits after this one; at most {max} can be rebased at once. Pick a more recent commit.
此提交之后没有其他提交，无需整理。: There are no commits after this one, so there is nothing to rebase.
该文件在此提交中使用其他名称，以下为全部改动 ·: The file had a different name in this commit; all of the commit's changes are shown below ·
此文件不是 UTF-8 编码，无法在此编辑。请在外部编辑器中解决后，回到「本地修: This file is not UTF-8 and can't be edited here. Resolve it in an external editor, then click “Mark as resolved” in “Local changes”.
此标签页已固定，取消固定后才能关闭。: This tab is pinned. Unpin it to close it.
此目录是仓库，可以打开: This directory is a repository and can be opened
当前系统不支持开机自动启动: Automatic startup is not yet supported on this system
当前系统不支持保存密码: Saving passwords is not supported on this system
此为 git 或 ssh 的原始提示，输入的内容不会被保存。: This is the original prompt from git or ssh. Your input is not saved.
这是公钥文件，请选择不带 .pub 后缀的私钥文件: This is a public key; choose the private key file without .pub
进程已结束。按回车重新启动。: Process ended. Press Enter to restart.
进程已结束（退出码 {code}）。按回车重新启动。: Process ended (exit code {code}). Press Enter to restart.
远程名称不能包含空格和斜杠: Remote names cannot contain spaces or slashes
无法连接远程仓库。请检查网络、代理和远程地址。: Cannot connect to the remote. Check the network, proxy, and remote address.
连续滚动（每帧 {BENCH_ROWS_PER_FRAME} 行）帧间隔: Continuous scrolling ({BENCH_ROWS_PER_FRAME} rows per frame) frame interval
选择文件以查看改动: Select a file to view its changes
选择文件以查看其历史或逐行追溯: Select a file to view its history or blame
其中的 {tabs} 个标签页将关闭，仓库仍保留在列表中。: The {tabs} {tabs|tab|tabs} in it will close; the repositories stay in the list.
顺序和操作均未更改，未执行变基。: Nothing was changed, so no rebase was run.
立即生效，已显示的通知不受影响。: Takes effect immediately; notifications already shown do not change.
与服务器的连接已断开，终端中的程序仍在运行。按 Enter 重新连接。: Disconnected from the server; the program is still running. Press Enter to reconnect.
服务器上的 kuaid 版本过旧（协议 {protocol}，客户端为 {PRO: kuaid on the server is too old (protocol {protocol}; the client uses {PROTOCOL_VERSION}) and could not be replaced. Run ~/.kuai/*/kuaid --stop on the server, then reconnect
发送图片或文件（也可拖放到此处，或复制后按 Ctrl+V）: Send images or files (or drop them here, or copy and press Ctrl+V)
在 Git 和终端页面之间切换（Ctrl+`）: Switch between the Git and Terminal pages (Ctrl+`)
运行在 {place} 上，关闭 Kuai 后仍会继续运行: Runs on {place}; keeps running after Kuai closes
运行在本机，关闭标签页后仍会继续运行: Runs on this computer; keeps running after the tab closes
此仓库没有打开的终端: No terminals are open for this repository
无法读取剪贴板中的图片：{err}: Could not read the image on the clipboard: {err}
同名文件过多: Too many files with the same name
{name} 上传失败：与服务器的连接已断开: Failed to upload {name}: the connection to the server was lost
上一批文件尚未发送完成。: The previous files are still being sent.
无法发送文件夹，请先压缩：{name}: Folders cannot be sent; zip it first: {name}
终端未运行，无法发送。: The terminal is not running; nothing was sent.
GitHub 未提供此文件的校验值: GitHub provides no checksum for this file
无法解析 GitHub 返回的数据: Could not parse the response from GitHub
下载文件的校验值与 GitHub 记录的不一致: The downloaded file does not match the checksum on GitHub
也可稍后重启，下次启动 Kuai 时将使用新版本。: You can restart later; the new version will be used the next time Kuai starts.
请前往下载页手动下载，或将 Kuai 移至有写入权限的文件夹后重试。: Download it manually from the releases page, or move Kuai to a writable folder and try again.
更新需要重启 Kuai，服务器上的终端不受影响。: Updating restarts Kuai; terminals on servers keep running.
发布包中包含不安全的路径: The package contains an unsafe path
发布包中缺少 kuai.exe: The package does not contain kuai.exe
无法启动新版本: Could not start the new version
启动时及之后每 6 小时检查一次 GitHub 上的新版本。: Checks GitHub for a new version at startup and every 6 hours.
开发版不支持自动更新: Development builds do not update automatically
当前程序不是发布版的 kuai.exe: This is not the released kuai.exe
未找到程序所在的文件夹: Could not find the program's folder
新版本未下载完成: The new version has not finished downloading
安装失败，日志位于 {path}: Installation failed; see the log at {path}
有 {n} 个本机终端正在运行，重启将结束其中的程序。服务器上的终端不受影响。: {n} local {n|terminal is|terminals are} still running; restarting ends {n|its program|their programs}. Terminals on servers keep running.
Kuai 已在运行，但未响应。请稍后重试，或在任务管理器中结束 Kuai。: Kuai is already running but is not responding. Try again later, or end Kuai in Task Manager.
此仓库有 {n} 个终端正在后台运行，将一并结束。: {n} {n|terminal is|terminals are} running in the background for this repository and will be ended.
展开侧栏以查看全部 {n} 项: Expand the sidebar to see all {n} {n|item|items}
